layout.arrangement: Title top-center in a light-blue banner; below it the slide is split into a left half with two stacked labeled example panels (Positive Class above Negative Class) and a right half with three stacked panels (Activation Function, Training, Evaluation). A small yellow slide-number circle sits at the top right.

layout.hierarchy: The title banner and color-coded section headers dominate; red Model boxes and yellow Predicted Class boxes are next; airplane sketches and the step plot are supporting illustrations.

visual_elements.description: Light blue rectangular banner with dark blue border containing the title text; the bracket range [-1,+1] appears accented/red.

Positive Class panel: red header “Shoot the Enemy”; tall red-bordered pale-pink box with five black line-art enemy/fighter aircraft sketches; narrow Label column to the right with +1 repeated five times, aligned one per aircraft.

Negative Class panel: green header “Safe”; tall green-bordered pale-green box with five black line-art passenger aircraft sketches; narrow Label column to the right with -1 repeated five times, aligned one per aircraft.

Small bi-polar step plot: y-levels -1 and +1, x threshold at 0; line is flat at -1 left of 0, jumps vertically at 0, then flat at +1 right of 0. Axis tick labels +1 and -1 are shown if legible; no other data values.
visual_elements.position: upper right inside Activation Function panel

visual_elements.description: Training flow: Input Sample -> Model (subcaption: (Any value) -> (-1,+1)) -> Predicted Class -> LOSS -> Label of Input Sample (+1,-1). Arrows point left-to-right.
Evaluation flow: Test Sample -> Model (subcaption: (Any value) -> (-1,+1)) -> Predicted Class (+1,-1). Arrows point left-to-right.
Yellow circle with black outline and black number 3.

imagery: Five simple black outline aircraft in the positive panel, enemy/fighter-style, some with small skull markings
Five simple black outline aircraft in the negative panel, passenger-style with window dots
Small purple step-function line icon in the Activation Function panel
typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title is bold and larger, centered in the banner. Section headers are bold and color-coded: red for Positive Class/Training/Evaluation, green for Negative Class, blue/purple for Activation Function. Body text is regular black; Model text is white bold on red; LOSS is white bold on orange. Curly quotes are used around “Shoot the Enemy”, “Safe”, and “zero”. No bullet glyphs are used.
animation_state: None; the slide is fully rendered with no mid-build state.
